bro.text: Saheeli Rai forges a temporal anchor and leads Teferi to Urza's tower, where he resolves to cross time to learn how to activate the sylex.
She shows him a perfect replica of the sylex and the nearly ready Anchor, and with Kaya and Jodah she installs and powers it up.
During a test the circuitry is torn apart by a ghostly presence, and Saheeli and Kaya spring a trap that gives the spirit a semblance of solidity, learning that he is General Sharaman.
Her insight is to send only Teferi's spirit back in time, and she keeps the Anchor running for him even as the Phyrexian attack comes.

lci.text: Saheeli Rai has lost the ability to planeswalk, standing on an Ixalan beach and finding nothing when she tries, but she theorizes that her spark and Huatli's were moved, not destroyed.
At the boy-emperor's court at Orazca she announces a long delay in his order of filigree quetzacama, and Atlacan threatens consequences if they are not delivered on time.
Huatli reveals a plan to depose Atlacan and asks Saheeli to speak with her voice at a secret meeting, so Saheeli is smuggled out to the coast and sails to meet Caztaca.

When Admiral Beckett Brass bursts in and takes control of the meeting, Saheeli urges the leaders to accept her demand, then seals the signed contract in a metal cylinder only she can open and pledges that she and Huatli will stand with Caztaca.
